topic_page.headline: Bulgaria Wins Eurovision 2026 in Vienna
topic_page.deck: Dara's "Bangaranga" triumphs with 516 points as five nations boycott over Israel's participation.
topic_page.summary: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest 2026 on May 16, 2026, in Vienna, Austria, with Dara's song "Bangaranga" securing 516 points. The 70th edition of the competition featured 25 countries competing in the Grand Final, but was overshadowed by a boycott from Iceland, Ireland, the Netherlands, Slovenia, and Spain over Israel's participation. Austria hosted the event as the reigning 2025 champion, with broadcaster ORF organizing the show.
